method.detail: Published method identity; implementation uses the declared shared-protocol adaptations.

retriever.detail: The method does not perform retrieval. CoA processes the supplied context in source order; prompting methods use only their question and demonstrations.

top_k.detail: Unused standard retrieval field; CoA reads every input candidate in original order.

max_steps.detail: 256-step execution limit; method-specific step units are documented in agent_parameters.md. Reaching the limit returns an error.

worker_window_tokens.detail: Appendix F.1 and main 8k experiments: agent context window 8k; implemented as 8192 tokens.

chat_overhead_tokens.detail: Reserve 64 tokens for chat framing, and explicit 1024-token carry plus 1024-token output; count question and instruction tokens before packing source sentences.
